text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOH!!)

A showdown that was never meant to be. 
Manhattan Cafe vs. Agnes Tachyon.

In the Senior Year's Arima Kinen, the 
ultimate showdown between contemporaries 
became a reality.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—"Returning after a long hiatus." What a 
dull phrase. Why try to force a single 
measure of time onto everyone?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I am—perfect right now. Better than ever, 
Cafe."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Is that... so... But there's no way for me 
to know...
(Vrroooooom...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... even I... can tell... that you are 
in top condition.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Because my 'friend'... seems to overlap 
with you just a little bit..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This has never happened even once... Was 
the one I was chasing after... you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it either... What lies... 
beyond you and me...

I didn't really understand what she meant, 
but Manhattan Cafe seemed to feel some 
sort of connection to it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san, there's something I must tell 
you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Without you, I never would 
have made it this far.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And I'm so glad... that I got to run with 
you once more.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, heh heh heh heh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, hahahaha! Hahahahaha...!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san...? What is so amusing?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you glad you were able to run? Why 
were you able to?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The one who brought this on――was you, 
wasn't it? Hmm?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was because you pushed the door open in 
the first place... that everything 
returned. Even time itself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Year. After the Satsuki Sho, I 
quit racing and transitioned into being 
your adviser.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I broke the hands of the clock. Yes, I 
didn't stop them; I broke them with my own 
hands. That was my decision.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I thought that would be fine. After all, 
there is no need for it to be my own.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And then, in the summer of your Senior 
year. At the Takarazuka Kinen, you stood 
at the threshold of the domain I 
envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hearing about that spectacle from you... 
my emotions were fiercely stirred! 
However, my decision was already made a 
year ago...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There are two options. You can either cry 
like a baby because it's out of reach, or—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should pretend the clock didn't 
break, but that I simply stopped it. 
Fortunately, I had science on my side.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Science has its impossibilities too. But 
that's not the issue. I simply had no 
reason to move science.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The reason why... is because I got my 
hands on a "key." At the end of an 
unexpected failure, I found the "key 
called emotion."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I sprang into action. Throwing everything 
else away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Through relentless research into my own 
body, I'll shatter the wall of near-zero 
probability—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Right now—standing here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a strange feeling. There's a will in 
this brain that says "I want to run." And 
receiving that will, my legs step firmly 
upon the earth. This sensation...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I can feel... life. The life of an 
Umamusume—which I thought I'd thrown 
away."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This rush of excitement tells me. All I 
ever needed was to "reach the peak through 
my own power."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Cafe. Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I... learned my true nature. That I'm just 
a helpless, ordinary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"And just like my gratitude... Cafe—I will 
never forgive you."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The world you caught a glimpse of belongs 
to me! —I won't let you reach it first.

I wasn't sure if I understood everything. 
Even so, Agnes Tachyon's sheer earnestness 
came through loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san... I can't put it into words 
very well, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I truly believe that my rival... is 
you..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is that so? To me, you are a rival as 
well...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —No, that's not right.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It just doesn't quite click with me. 
Competing, teaming up, having someone look 
after your daily life...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Reality is multifaceted, after all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... Being rivals should be enough... 
After I went out of my way to acknowledge 
you, too...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, that's right. I know just the words 
for this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafe. Your behavior is suspicious, and you 
seem rather faint and blurry, yet you 
still guided me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Such an existence would surely be called 
this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —With the "friend."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Run as you please. And catch up to it. To 
your 'friend.'

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of running in the same 
race. I'll catch up in my own way. To my 
'friend,' that is.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san... Yes... please come...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But... I won't be overtaken. I will reach 
what lies beyond my goal—!

Pursuing different things, the two of them 
still do not cross paths, even having come 
this far.

Seeking their own horizons— they head 
toward the same gates.
